process.title: Discovery call
process.text: A free 30-minute call about the space, the brief, and the budget.

process.title: Site visit and proposal
process.text: The studio measures the space and sends a fixed design fee and a furnishing budget range.

process.title: Design
process.text: Layouts, material palette, and a full furnishing plan. Two revision rounds.

process.title: Procurement
process.text: The studio orders every piece and manages makers and lead times.

process.title: Installation and styling
process.text: The crew delivers, installs, and styles the space, usually within one week on site.

process.title: Handover
process.text: A walkthrough, a care guide, and a 30-day follow-up visit.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Furnishing projects start at ₱1,500,000, including the design fee. The design fee is fixed and quoted per project, based on floor area and scope. The furnishing budget is separate. You pay listed prices for the pieces, and we add no hidden markup on shop items.

faq.question: How long does a project take?
faq.answer: Most projects take 12 to 20 weeks from signed proposal to handover. Made-to-order lead times set most of that time. Installation usually takes about one week on site.

faq.question: How do payments work?
faq.answer: You pay 50 percent of the design fee when you sign and 50 percent when you approve the design. You pay 70 percent of the furnishing budget before we order and 30 percent before installation.

faq.question: Do you work outside Metro Manila?
faq.answer: Yes. We work anywhere in the Philippines. Outside Metro Manila and Calabarzon, the proposal states travel and freight costs.

faq.question: Can you renovate or build cabinets?
faq.answer: No. We do not build, renovate, or install cabinetry, plumbing, or wiring. The space should be finished before we start.

faq.question: How many changes can I ask for?
faq.answer: The design stage includes two revision rounds. We settle the layout, materials, and furnishing plan with you before we order anything.

process.title: Brief and measurements
process.text: The client supplies floor plans and photos, or books a paid site measure.

process.title: Concept
process.text: Moodboard, material palette, and layout options.

process.title: Design development
process.text: Final layouts, renders of key rooms, and specifications. Two revision rounds.

process.title: Delivery
process.text: A design book and a sourcing list. One follow-up call within 60 days.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: From ₱2,500 per square meter. Minimum fee ₱150,000. For a 100 sqm home, the fee is ₱250,000. You pay 50 percent when you sign and 50 percent before we deliver the design book.

faq.question: What do I receive?
faq.answer: You receive a design book with layouts, a moodboard, a material palette, color and lighting direction, renders of key rooms, room-by-room specifications, and a sourcing list. The design stage includes two revision rounds.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: Most projects take 5 to 8 weeks. We include one follow-up call within 60 days of delivery.

faq.question: Who buys and installs the pieces?
faq.answer: You do. Our sourcing list draws on the shop first, then on outside sources. We do not order, deliver, or install. We also do not build or manage contractor work. If your space needs that, finish it before we start.

faq.question: Can you work with a home that is far away?
faq.answer: Yes. We deliver this service remotely, anywhere. You send floor plans and photos, or you book a paid site measure if you are in range.

faq.question: Can I move to full furnishing later?
faq.answer: Yes. You can upgrade to Full-Service Furnishing, and we credit the design fee you have already paid.
